title: Stoner Rock
tagline: Heavy riffs with a slow, drifting pulse.
summary: Stoner rock stretches riff-based rock into slower, more hypnotic forms, often with a warm psychedelic haze. It draws on blues, hard rock and acid rock without needing speed as its main weapon. The result is music that feels tactile and spacious, balancing heaviness with trancelike repetition.

pillars.name: Kyuss
pillars.why: Kyuss made fuzz, groove and atmosphere feel as important as melody.

pillars.name: Sleep
pillars.why: Sleep stretched the genre into a dense, hypnotic language of slow riffs and huge volume.

pillars.name: Monster Magnet
pillars.why: Monster Magnet gave the form a sharper, more melodic edge while keeping its heavy drift.
